label: recruit
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local n = 0 for _, c in ipairs({ "S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679", "S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255", "S_Player_Gale_ad9af97d-75da-406a-ae13-7071c563f604", "S_Player_Laezel_58a69333-40bf-8358-1d17-fff240d7fb12", "S_Player_Wyll_c774d764-4a17-48dc-b470-32ace9ce447d", "S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c" }) do if c:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) and n < 3 and Ext.Entity.Get(c:sub(-36)) then pcall(Osi.SetOnStage, c, 1) pcall(Osi.TeleportTo, c, H, "", 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) pcall(Osi.PROC_GLO_PartyMembers_Add, c, H) n = n + 1 end end return GK.Stage.Party()

label: party-fight
server: Scene = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "goblin", count = 4, faction = "enemy", distance = 8, equipment = { "longsword" } } return Scene

label: companion-death
server: GK.Stage.Guard(false) local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then Osi.SetImmortal(m, 0) Osi.Die(m, 0, "NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", 0, 1, 0) SceneDead = m break end end return SceneDead

then.server: if SceneDead then Osi.UseSpell(Osi.GetHostCharacter(), "Target_Revivify_Scroll", SceneDead) end return true
if SceneDead then Osi.Resurrect(SceneDead, "", 0) end GK.Stage.Guard(true) return true

label: downed-and-helped
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then Osi.ApplyStatus(m, "DOWNED", 18.0, 1, m) SceneDead = m break end end return SceneDead

then.server: if SceneDead then Osi.UseSpell(Osi.GetHostCharacter(), "Target_Help", SceneDead) end return true

label: fall
server: local p = GK.Stage.Position() Osi.TeleportToPosition(Osi.GetHostCharacter(), p[1], p[2] + 14, p[3], "", 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) return true

then.server: local p = GK.Stage.Position() Osi.CharacterMoveToPosition(Osi.GetHostCharacter(), p[1] + 6, p[2], p[3], "Sneak", "") return true

label: crime-assault
server: Scene = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "human", count = 2, faction = "neutral", distance = 4 } return Scene

label: crime-theft
server: Scene = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "human", count = 1, faction = "neutral", distance = 3 } ScenePick = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "potion", distance = 2 }[1] return ScenePick

then.server: pcall(Osi.SetOwner, ScenePick, Scene[1]) Osi.ToInventory(ScenePick, Osi.GetHostCharacter(), 1, 1, 0) return true

label: inventory
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, name in ipairs({ "potion", "dagger", "scroll_fireball", "thieves_tools", "torch" }) do Osi.TemplateAddTo(GK.Stage.Templates[name], H, 5, 1) end return true

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local other for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then other = m end end local p = GK.Find(GK.Stage.Templates.potion)[1] if other and p then Osi.ToInventory(p, other, 2, 1, 0) end local d = GK.Find(GK.Stage.Templates.dagger)[1] if d then pcall(Osi.SendToCampChest, d, H) end return true
local s = GK.Find(GK.Stage.Templates.scroll_fireball)[1] if s then Osi.Use(Osi.GetHostCharacter(), s, "") end return true

label: gold-and-xp
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() Osi.AddGold(H, 500) Osi.AddExplorationExperience(H, 3000) pcall(Osi.AddExplorationExperience, GK.Stage.Party()[2] or H, 3000) return true

label: approval
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then pcall(Osi.ChangeApprovalRating, m, H, 0, 5) pcall(Osi.ChangeApprovalRating, m, H, 0, -3) end end return true

then.server: local rows = GK.Stage.Usables("Lie", { limit = 1 }) if rows[1] then GK.Stage.UseItem(rows[1].uuid) end return rows
local rows = GK.Stage.Usables("OpenClose", { limit = 2 }) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do GK.Stage.UseItem(r.uuid) end return #rows

label: waypoint
server: local rows = GK.Stage.Triggers("teleport", { limit = 3 }) if rows[1] then GK.Stage.Visit(rows[1].uuid, nil, true) end return rows

label: dismiss
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then pcall(Osi.PROC_GLO_PartyMembers_Remove, m, H, 1) end end return GK.Stage.Party()
